column2:
wage(n.)工資、薪水、wages(n.)工資(常用複數)
(無詞性變化)
minimum wage 基本工資
earn a wage 賺取工資
The government raised the minimum wage this year.
(政府今年調漲了基本工資。)
Workers asked for higher wages and shorter hours.
(工人們要求更高的工資和更短的工時。)

wagon(n.)四輪馬車、貨車、手推車
(無詞性變化)
covered wagon 篷車
station wagon 旅行車
The farmer loaded the hay onto the wagon.
(農夫把乾草裝上馬車。)
Kids pulled a little red wagon full of toys.
(孩子們拉著一台裝滿玩具的紅色小拖車。)

wander(v./n.)漫遊、閒逛、走神
wanderer(n.)流浪者
wander around 四處閒逛
mind wanders 思緒飄走
We wandered around the old streets of Jiufen.
(我們在九份的老街四處閒逛。)
My mind began to wander during the long speech.
(冗長的演講中我開始走神。)

warmth(n.)溫暖、熱情
warm(adj./v.)溫暖的、使暖和
warmth of the sun 陽光的溫暖
family warmth 家庭溫暖
The cat enjoyed the warmth of the sun.
(那隻貓享受著陽光的溫暖。)
We were moved by the warmth of the local people.
(我們被當地人的熱情所感動。)

warn(v.)警告、提醒
warning(n.)警告
warn someone of/about 警告某人……
warn someone not to 警告某人不要
The teacher warned us not to be late again.
(老師警告我們不要再遲到。)
The news warned people about the coming typhoon.
(新聞警告民眾颱風即將來襲。)

waterfall(n.)瀑布
(無詞性變化)
beautiful waterfall 美麗的瀑布
hike to a waterfall 健行到瀑布
Shifen Waterfall is a famous spot in New Taipei.
(十分瀑布是新北市的著名景點。)
We hiked for two hours to see the waterfall.
(我們健行了兩個小時去看瀑布。)

wax(n./v.)蠟、上蠟
waxy(adj.)似蠟的
candle wax 蠟燭蠟
wax the floor 給地板打蠟
The candle wax dripped onto the table.
(蠟燭的蠟滴到了桌上。)
He waxed his car until it was shiny.
(他替車子打蠟，直到閃閃發亮。)

weaken(v.)削弱、使變弱
weak(adj.)虛弱的
weakness(n.)弱點
weaken the body 使身體變虛弱
the typhoon weakens 颱風減弱
Staying up late can weaken your body.
(熬夜會使你的身體變虛弱。)
The typhoon weakened after it hit the mountains.
(颱風撞上山脈後減弱了。)

wealthy(adj.)富有的、富裕的
wealth(n.)財富
wealthy family 富裕的家庭
the wealthy 富人
He was born into a wealthy family.
(他出生在一個富裕的家庭。)
Being wealthy does not always make people happy.
(富有不一定會讓人快樂。)

weapon(n.)武器
weaponry(n.)武器(總稱)
nuclear weapon 核子武器
secret weapon 祕密武器
Carrying weapons on a plane is not allowed.
(搭飛機不得攜帶武器。)
Her smile is her secret weapon.
(她的微笑是她的祕密武器。)

weave(v./n.)編織、織法
weaver(n.)織布工
weave a basket 編籃子
weave through 穿梭於
The Atayal people are famous for weaving.
(泰雅族以編織聞名。)
The motorcycle weaved through the traffic.
(那輛機車在車陣中穿梭。)

web(n.)網、蜘蛛網、網路
website(n.)網站
spider web 蜘蛛網
surf the Web 上網
A spider web hung in the corner of the room.
(房間角落掛著一張蜘蛛網。)
I found the information on the Web.
(我在網路上找到了這個資料。)

wed(v.)結婚、與……結婚
wedding(n.)婚禮
newly wed 新婚的
be wed to 與……結婚
The couple will wed in June.
(那對情侶將在六月結婚。)
The newly wed couple went to Japan for their honeymoon.
(那對新婚夫妻去日本度蜜月。)

weed(n./v.)雜草、除草
(無詞性變化)
pull weeds 拔草
weed out 剔除
Grandpa pulls weeds in the garden every morning.
(爺爺每天早上在花園拔草。)
The coach weeded out the weaker players.
(教練剔除了實力較弱的球員。)

weekly(adj./adv./n.)每週的、每週一次、週刊
week(n.)週
weekly meeting 每週會議
weekly magazine 週刊
We have a weekly meeting every Monday.
(我們每週一開週會。)
The report is updated weekly.
(這份報告每週更新一次。)

weep(v.)哭泣、流淚
(無詞性變化)
weep for joy 喜極而泣
weep bitterly 痛哭
She wept for joy when she got the news.
(她得知消息時喜極而泣。)
The little girl wept over her lost dog.
(小女孩為她走失的狗哭泣。)

wheat(n.)小麥
(無詞性變化)
whole wheat 全麥
wheat flour 麵粉
Whole wheat bread is good for your health.
(全麥麵包對健康有益。)
Bread and noodles are made from wheat flour.
(麵包和麵條是用麵粉做的。)

whip(n./v.)鞭子、鞭打、攪打
(無詞性變化)
whipped cream 打發的鮮奶油
crack the whip 嚴加管教
Whip the cream until it becomes thick.
(把鮮奶油打到變濃稠。)
The man whipped the horse to make it run faster.
(那個人鞭打馬匹讓牠跑快一點。)

whistle(n./v.)哨子、口哨、吹口哨
(無詞性變化)
blow a whistle 吹哨子
whistle a tune 吹口哨哼曲子
The referee blew the whistle to start the game.
(裁判吹哨宣布比賽開始。)
He was whistling a happy tune on his way home.
(他在回家路上吹著輕快的曲子。)

wicked(adj.)邪惡的、惡劣的、淘氣的
wickedness(n.)邪惡
wicked witch 邪惡的女巫
wicked smile 不懷好意的笑容
The wicked witch put the princess to sleep.
(邪惡的女巫讓公主陷入沉睡。)
He gave me a wicked smile.
(他對我露出不懷好意的笑容。)

widen(v.)加寬、擴大
wide(adj.)寬的
width(n.)寬度
widen the road 拓寬道路
widen the gap 擴大差距
The city plans to widen the road next year.
(市政府計畫明年拓寬這條路。)
Her eyes widened in surprise.
(她驚訝得睜大了眼睛。)

wipe(v./n.)擦、擦拭
wiper(n.)雨刷
wipe off 擦掉
wet wipes 濕紙巾
Please wipe the table after dinner.
(晚餐後請擦桌子。)
She wiped the tears off her face.
(她擦掉臉上的淚水。)

wisdom(n.)智慧、明智
wise(adj.)有智慧的
wisdom tooth 智齒
words of wisdom 至理名言
My grandmother is a woman of great wisdom.
(我奶奶是一位很有智慧的女性。)
I had my wisdom tooth pulled last week.
(我上週拔了智齒。)

wrap(v./n.)包、裹、包裝
wrapper(n.)包裝紙
wrapping(n.)包裝材料
wrap a gift 包禮物
wrap up 結束、包好
She wrapped the gift in red paper.
(她用紅色的紙包裝禮物。)
Let's wrap up the meeting now.
(我們現在結束會議吧。)

wrist(n.)手腕
wristwatch(n.)手錶
sprain one's wrist 扭傷手腕
wrist injury 手腕受傷
He hurt his wrist while playing tennis.
(他打網球時傷了手腕。)
She wore a silver bracelet on her wrist.
(她手腕上戴著一條銀手鍊。)

yearly(adj./adv.)每年的、每年一次
year(n.)年
yearly event 年度活動
yearly income 年收入
The school fair is a yearly event.
(學校園遊會是一年一度的活動。)
The festival is held yearly in October.
(這個節慶每年十月舉行。)

yell(v./n.)大叫、吼叫
(無詞性變化)
yell at 對……大吼
yell for help 大聲呼救
Please don't yell at your little brother.
(請不要對你弟弟大吼。)
The boy yelled for help when he fell into the river.
(男孩掉進河裡時大聲呼救。)

yolk(n.)蛋黃
(無詞性變化)
egg yolk 蛋黃
separate the yolk 分離蛋黃
I like eggs with soft yolks.
(我喜歡蛋黃半熟的蛋。)
Separate the yolks from the whites first.
(先把蛋黃和蛋白分開。)

youngster(n.)年輕人、小孩
young(adj.)年輕的
local youngsters 當地年輕人
talented youngster 有天分的年輕人
The park is full of youngsters on weekends.
(週末公園裡滿是年輕人。)
The coach is training a group of talented youngsters.
(教練正在訓練一群有天分的年輕人。)

zipper(n./v.)拉鍊、拉上拉鍊
zip(v.)拉上拉鍊
zip code 郵遞區號
pull up a zipper 拉上拉鍊
The zipper on my jacket is broken.
(我外套上的拉鍊壞了。)
Pull up your zipper before you go out.
(出門前把拉鍊拉上。)

zone(n./v.)地帶、區域、劃分區域
(無詞性變化)
time zone 時區
no-parking zone 禁止停車區
Taiwan and Japan are in different time zones.
(台灣和日本處於不同的時區。)
You can't park here. It's a no-parking zone.
(你不能停在這裡，這是禁止停車區。)
